accepted-residual-risk: with a single GitHub account, independent non-author review is satisfied by an independent agent reviewer rather than a separate human colleague; accepted by the operator in the plan's Approval contract section
approval-contract-section: Approval contract (amended 2026-09-20 by explicit operator decision)
backward-compatibility: waves merged before W4 carry (or lack) authorization only in delivered bindings that are never re-merged; new merges require the same evidence-record shape — no second, divergent format is accepted

merge-gate-requires.carrier: the committed wave evidence record's `merge-authorization` object
merge-gate-requires.content-equality: digest(base, receipt) == digest(base, merge tip) == the recorded content-digest, so the merge delivers exactly the authorized content
merge-gate-requires.head-binding: head must equal the evidence record's `implementation-sha` (the verified receipt head); a committed record cannot contain its own commit SHA, so the exact-head binding is enforced against the receipt head and, via excluded-paths digest equality, against the merge tip

merge-gate-requires.carrier: the schema-2 review artifact referenced by the evidence record
required-properties: reviewer non-empty and != the PR author
reviewed-sha == the verified implementation head (F3 binding)

refusal-taxonomy.head-binding-mismatch: review reviewed-sha bound to a head other than the verified implementation head
refusal-taxonomy.no-operator-authorization: missing/empty object, missing or blank field, foreign wave, head not equal to the verified implementation head, or content drift between the receipt and the merge tip
refusal-taxonomy.no-review-artifact: missing/malformed review datum, non-APPROVED verdict, or no non-author reviewer identity

replaces: independent_approval(): a native GitHub review by a non-author human at the exact head — unsatisfiable by construction in this single-account repository
